findings.body: If a draft spec has a committed read round with findings, a later commit can delete its `.read.md` file. The deleted notes path is in `changed`, but `story.show` returns `None`, so this condition skips `story.gate`. After updating the review, the pull-request check can pass even though `spec confirm` refuses the same spec for having no cold read. The check needs to distinguish a draft that was never read from one whose read notes were removed.
findings.title: Deleting failed read notes bypasses the spec PR gate
